brief.text: is checked to ensure that only values with known valid type tags can be used (sometimes transparently) in non-unit contexts.

content.text: At the time of implementation, this includes all known tags, but more may be added in the future, and they should not be added automatically unless determined to be appropriate.

definition.text: = Valid<T> && (std::is_same_v<typename T::UnitType, feelevelTag> || std::is_same_v<typename T::UnitType, unitlessTag> || std::is_same_v<typename T::UnitType, dropTag> || std::is_same_v<typename T::UnitType, BipsTag> || std::is_same_v<typename T::UnitType, TenthBipsTag>)

declaration.text:
template <class T>
concept Usable = template<class T> concept

= Valid<T> && (std::is_same_v<typename T::UnitType, feelevelTag> || std::is_same_v<typename T::UnitType, unitlessTag> || std::is_same_v<typename T::UnitType, dropTag> || std::is_same_v<typename T::UnitType, BipsTag> || std::is_same_v<typename T::UnitType, TenthBipsTag>)
